plang/programming-fundamentals/1-1-terms.comment: The document offers an exceptionally clear and intuitive breakdown of core software development terms, successfully highlighting the functional necessity of intermediate build stages like ASTs and assembly. However, while it effectively contrasts key trade-offs like compile-time safety versus runtime flexibility, it operates primarily as an introductory overview rather than an exhaustive theoretical deep dive.

plang/programming-fundamentals/1-2-class.comment: The document provides a remarkably clear, structured, and accessible overview of programming language taxonomies, clearly contrasting operational mechanisms and trade-offs.
